I'm an M.S. in Business Analytics student at Baruch College (Zicklin), expected 2026.

I work in R and Python — this semester that's meant Quarto reporting and dplyr, plus building containerised applications on AWS with Docker. I'm particularly interested in how analytics projects get planned and measured: deciding what would count as evidence before building the thing.

This site collects my coursework and mini-projects for STA 9750.

```{r baruch-map}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if(!require("leaflet")){
    options(repos = c(CRAN = "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
    install.packages("leaflet")
    stopifnot(require("leaflet"))
}

baruch_longitude <- -73.98333
baruch_latitude  <- +40.74028

leaflet() |>
  addTiles() |>
  setView(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude, zoom = 17) |>
  addPopups(baruch_longitude, baruch_latitude,
            "M.S. in Business Analytics at <b>Baruch College</b>")
```
